key_insight: Noise can derail ADAPT-VQE’s operator-selection step, but targeted error mitigation can restore convergence even on near-term hardware.
engineering_relevance: For quantum algorithm deployment, this shows that robustness must be engineered not only into parameter optimization but also into the adaptive operator-selection loop.
method: Tested ADAPT-VQE on linear H3 under a range of coherent and incoherent noise channels
Evaluated the operator-selection step rather than only the parameter-optimization step
Combined dynamical decoupling, zero-noise extrapolation, and Pauli twirling to mitigate noise
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that sufficiently high noise rates prevent convergence, while appropriately combined mitigation techniques restore a successful convergence profile in the H3 case study.
watch_item: Results are demonstrated on a single small molecular benchmark, so effectiveness and overhead may differ for larger systems and hardware-specific noise models.
paper_title: A Case Study on Noise Resilient Operator Selection in Adaptive Variational Quantum Algorithms
